summary: NOVONIX Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing delivery of a mass production qualification sample (C-sample) of synthetic graphite anode material to Panasonic. This is an operational milestone, not a corporate special situation. No deal terms, no M&A, no restructuring. The filing confirms the company expects mass production to begin in H2 2027 subject to Panasonic's assessment. No financial terms, premiums, or board actions are mentioned. This is a routine operational update with no special-situation implications.
